admission.justification: Spans report lifecycle states: reusing recorded stamps for unchanged files, pruning absent rows, retiring obsolete caches, and keeping collected closed receipts truthful after folder removal is FAM-2BRZW7's retention discipline.

applicability: Every settlement of collected report state: stamps, file rows, receipt caches and closed receipts.
conditions: An unchanged file reuses its recorded source and canonical stamps.
A path absent from the current inventory is pruned.
exclusions: Growing stale rows across create/collect/delete cycles.
A collected closed receipt turning untruthful after its local folder is gone.
statement: Unchanged report files reuse recorded source/canonical stamps; absent rows are pruned, obsolete receipt caches retire, and a collected closed receipt remains truthful after its local folder is gone.
